# What will you create in 3D today?
Meshy is a free AI 3D model generator that turns text or images into ready-to-use 3D models in under a minute.

## [High-Fidelity Image-to-3D](https://www.meshy.ai/features/image-to-3d)
Upload a photo, sketch, or piece of concept art, and Meshy turns it into a 3D model you can print, use in a game, or refine further.

## The Only 3D AI Trained to Print
Meshy 3D models are generated with printing in mind — watertight, manifold, and ready to slice.

Meshy models come out watertight and manifold. A built-in printability check still scans every export and auto-repairs any edge cases before you slice.

Multi-color printing maps each texture to the right filament, with clean color boundaries.
